layer.description: Uneven pine groups climb both rocky side slopes and thin into isolated trees on the far ridges. Open stone remains between the groups.
Mixed silverwood and aspen groups extend the garden into loose woodland on both side hills, with lighter distant crowns and open gaps.
Small apple-tree groups continue the orchard along both side slopes, with separated crowns on the far ridges. The lane and standing area stay open.
Sparse acacia pairs and single ridge trees continue the dry landscape at both sides, leaving broad gaps of open ground.
Jungle-tree clumps with the generator's hanging vines continue both banks into the distant side hills, separated by misty openings.
Loose gravewood groups and isolated crooked trees line the cemetery's side slopes and far ridges, with bare ground visible between them.
